perQuery.note: Elicit retrieves both required landmark trials at ranks 1 and 2, while Manan finds the 6-year Evolut paper but misses the PARTNER 3 primary trial.
Both systems retrieve the exact DAPA-HF paper, but Elicit ranks it first whereas Manan buries it at rank 6.
Manan over-prioritizes very recent low-level and mechanistic items while missing CLARITY-AD, whereas Elicit ranks CLARITY-AD first and includes major follow-up evidence.
Elicit is more tightly focused on placebo-controlled cardiovascular mortality meta-analyses in T2DM, while Manan includes several kidney, heart-failure, and non-placebo-adjacent distractors.
Manan includes the 2024, 2020, 2016, and 2010 ESC AF guidelines with full identifiers, despite ranking older guidelines above the newest one.
Neither system retrieves the pivotal DOAC RCTs, but Manan ranks the strongest patient-level network meta-analysis first while Elicit leads with a secondary commentary.

overall.summary: Elicit wins four of six queries, mainly through stronger landmark recall and better ranking of exact or must-have papers. Manan performs well on metadata and guidelines, but it misses key landmark evidence in several clinically important searches and includes more off-target items.
